product.title: Cortech Corner Guards - CG
product.body_html:
Cortech Corner Guards protect drywall, plaster, and concrete corners from chips, dings and damage.  Perfect for use all over commercial and institutional facilities - in kitchens, high traffic hallways, storage spaces, parking garages and anywhere carts, forklifts or dollies are used.

  • Made of PVC
  • Aesthetic design with smooth finish and beveled edge for finished look
  • Beveled edge for finished look
  • Easy Installation
  • Easy to clean with soap and water solution
  • Your choice of mounting option:
    • Double sided adhesive tape, factory installed
    • Tamper-resistant screws, hardware included
  • Weather resistant for interior or exterior use
  • Bullnose corner guards available for rounded or obtuse angles
  • Available in 5 colors
  • Available in Flame Retardant or General Use. Clear Corner Guards and Corner Guards with adhesive are not flame retardant
  • Made in USA
  • Price is per piece. Packed 20/case. Must buy in full cases

Cortech corner guards are ideal for continuous, intensive use in extreme or high traffic environments. 

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
